description: Send a session a message, as if the person typed it: a prompt when it is idle, a nudge to its running turn when it is busy. It arrives marked as coming from you. Use it only when the person asks you to act on a session. The target machine's steer setting decides whether you may (by default: when you are attended, or you started the session); a refusal says so. Works for interactive Claude Code sessions with the gruntas plugin and sessions gruntas runs; other sessions are refused with the reason. Answers take a few seconds: other machines are asked at their next refresh.

session.description: The session's id, as gruntas_status lists it.

name: gruntas_message
